intro.h2: Kitchen remodeling in Houston, from design to the last cabinet pull
paragraphs: Remont Group is a kitchen remodeler serving Houston, TX. Our reviewers describe two sides of the work coming together: a designer's creative vision and the craftsmanship of the builders who carry it out. One homeowner says her finished kitchen went beyond what she expected, and that timely completion and open communication made the whole process stress-free.

Cabinet installation is where precision shows. A customer who hired us to install his kitchen cabinets points to the alignment, the hardware placement and the overall look, and calls the job timely and affordable. We take on small jobs as well: Omer once patched a hole in a customer's drywall quickly and at a fair price.

items.name: Kitchen design and remodeling
items.blurb: A remodel with us can begin with a design you can see before anything is built. The rendering here plans an L-shaped kitchen with white and charcoal cabinets, long bar pulls and a marble-look backsplash. One customer credits our designer and builders for a kitchen beyond her expectations.

items.name: Kitchen cabinet installation
items.blurb: We install kitchen cabinets with close attention to alignment and hardware placement, the details one customer singled out in his review. This coffee and wine station pairs white shaker base cabinets and a beverage fridge with glass-front uppers, a lattice wine rack and crown molding.

items.name: Drywall patches and small repairs
items.blurb: Not every job is a whole kitchen. One customer had a small hole in his drywall, and Omer fixed it quickly and at an affordable price. If a wall needs patching before or after a bigger project, mention it when you call and we will take a look.

Our team brings design and building together: reviewers mention both a designer with a creative eye and builders whose craftsmanship and attention to detail stood out. Most of our work centers on kitchens, from full remodels to cabinet installation, and we still say yes to smaller jobs like drywall repair. items.name: Kurmanbek Z.
items.text:
I am thrilled to share my recent experience working with Remont Group for the installation of kitchen cabinets in my home. 
The service provided not only met but exceeded my expectations in terms of timeliness, affordability, and the outstanding quality of the final results. The installation of the kitchen cabinets showcased a level of precision and craftsmanship that left me thoroughly impressed. The meticulous attention to detail, including alignment, hardware placement, and overall aesthetics, demonstrated the skill and professionalism of the Remont Group team. The end result was a kitchen that not only met but exceeded my design expectations.

items.name: Elif D.
items.text: I recently had my kitchen remodeled by Remont Group, and the experience was nothing short of exceptional. The team demonstrated unparalleled professionalism from start to finish. The designer's creative vision combined with the craftsmanship of the builders resulted in a kitchen that exceeded my expectations. The attention to detail, timely completion, and open communication made the entire process stress-free. I highly recommend Remont Group for anyone looking for top-notch kitchen remodeling services.

items.name: Sumanth G.
items.text: I had a small hole in my drywall, remount group Omer was really helpful quick in action and fix the hole in affordable price.

service_area.text: Remont Group works with homeowners in Houston, TX. Google does not show a street address or a list of neighborhoods for us yet, so the easiest way to check whether we cover your part of town is to call (346) 603-8514. Tell us where your home is and whether you need a full kitchen remodel, cabinet installation or a smaller repair.

items.q: Do you only work on kitchens?
items.a: Kitchens are our main work, from full remodels with design to cabinet installation. We also take smaller jobs: Omer once fixed a small hole in a customer's drywall quickly and at an affordable price. Call us to describe your project and we will tell you whether it is a fit.

Yes. One customer hired us specifically to install the kitchen cabinets in his home and singled out the alignment, hardware placement and overall look. We also put together pieces like the coffee and wine station on this page, with glass-front uppers, a wine rack and a beverage fridge.

items.q: Can you help with the design?
items.a: Yes. A homeowner who had her kitchen remodeled by us credits our designer's creative vision, combined with the craftsmanship of our builders, for a kitchen that exceeded her expectations. Bring photos, measurements and ideas you like, and we will work through the layout with you.

We are open Monday through Friday from 9 AM to 5 PM and Saturday from 10 AM to 5 PM, and closed on Sunday. Call (346) 603-8514 during those hours, or email remontgroupllc@gmail.com with photos of your kitchen and a short note about your plans.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Call or email us with a few photos and a description of what you want to change. We will talk through the layout and cabinets with you and give you a price before any work begins. Customers describe our pricing as affordable on large and small jobs alike.
